translations.web: Everyone who is found will be thrust through. Everyone who is captured will fall by the sword.
translations.bsb: Whoever is caught will be stabbed, and whoever is captured will die by the sword.
translations.kjv: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword.
translations.asv: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is taken shall fall by the sword.
